review_kind: AI technical audit only; no engineering disposition or human approval
approval_state: Delegated approvals paused by user; this file authors no approvals

scope.method: Read-only visual inspection of existing original fullpage PNGs using view_image, and static inspection of templates, manifest and builder. No local CAD generation, rendering, tests or browser used. Models assessed from exact input features and shipped manifest rather than a newly rendered visual.

rules.mvp: mvp.md lines8,112,123: keep independently supported cuts, unknown essential geometry blocks generation, no bounding-box substitutions; current supported outlines rectangle/circle/ring and hole/slot cuts.
rules.proposal: proposal.md B5 lines938-985 includes corners, side faces and pockets in full design, but mvp.md wins over proposal. Path grooves, bent/welded pieces and bonus revolved profiles require explicit scope extension.
rules.inference: No geometry measured from pixels. Pattern/symmetry interpretations must be marked as such. Scan values must acquire page/image-grounded facts through fresh Sol proposer then Opus verifier; absence of parsed number ID is ingestion state, not proof the dimension is unprinted.

Consider exact rounded/capsule outline support for D-016 and D-028; both have dimensioned nominal geometry without inventing contour.
Repair scan geometry ingestion for D-003/D-011/D-020/D-023 before claiming numbers are unavailable solely because PDF contains no text.

Do not turn D-020R65.5 hole radius into groove radius; establish the section datums first.
